item.title: Watch: Drop Shot EP 10 | Chennai’s bookstores, Kaber Vasuki, Hyderabad bagels and a 50-year-old croc bank
item.description: In Episode 10, we explore four stories that capture the changing cultural landscape of Chennai and beyond. From North Chennai’s neighbourhood bookstores that continue to nurture reading communities, to indie musician Kaber Vasuki and his distinctive musical journey, we meet people and spaces shaping contemporary culture. We also travel to Hyderabad, where a homegrown bagel brand is heading to New York’s Bagel Fest, and look at the Madras Crocodile Bank as it marks 50 years of conservation, education and reptile care.

item.title: Drop Shot EP 09 | Once More, Incels, Art Deco & Yash’s Toxic Fairy Tale
item.description: In this episode, we bring together four stories from the worlds of cinema, culture, society and Chennai’s history. Arjun Das and Aditi Shankar talk about Once More and choosing stories that connect with them. Writer Meena Kandasamy examines the world of the Indian incel and the ideas behind it. We step inside the Art Deco story of The Hindu’s iconic Chennai building, and look at Yash and Geetu Mohandas’ Toxic, a dark fairy tale for grown-ups.

item.title: Watch: Drop Shot Ep. 4 | Jana Nayagan Fever, The Keeper of the Wells & Gaurav Gupta’s Light Song
item.description: In this episode, we capture the excitement surrounding Vijay’s Jana Nayagan as fans celebrate what could be the actor’s final film and director H. Vinoth shares insights into the much-awaited release. We then explore The Keeper of the Wells, as Chennai-based author Zhayynn James discusses his debut novel inspired by the historic Seven Wells neighbourhood of North Chennai. Finally, we head to Mumbai for a look at designer Gaurav Gupta’s latest bridal couture collection, Light Song, where sculptural silhouettes, intricate craftsmanship and contemporary design redefine modern bridal fashion.

item.title: Watch: Drop Shot Episode 2 | From Wall Street to World Cup fever and storm chasers
item.description: Chef Vijay Kumar’s journey from rural Tamil Nadu to ringing the Nasdaq closing bell, and his mission to take Tamil cuisine global. Kerala’s World Cup fever comes alive with football-themed mundus, murals, giant cut-outs and homes painted in team colours. West Bengal’s storm chasers track cyclones, thunderstorms and lightning, blending adventure, photography and weather science. Preity Mukhundhan and Niharika NM on Idhayam Murali, discussing their characters, on-screen chemistry and the film’s slice-of-life story.

item.title: Watch: DROP SHOT | Episode 1 – The Week in Features
item.description: In the first episode of DROP SHOT, filmmaker Imtiaz Ali reflects on his upcoming Partition drama Main Vaapas Aaunga and why it is among his most personal films. We then step into the world of Son of Thanjai, the ambitious open-world Tamil video game drawing global attention. Next, Dr Priya Selvaraj recounts her life-changing journey to the summit of Mount Everest and the battle to survive the descent. We wrap up in Chandannagar, West Bengal, tracing the fascinating history of the newly GI-tagged jalbhara, a sandesh steeped in heritage, craftsmanship and tradition.
